content.json:
# Azure OpenAI · Native Operations
Azure Monitor Workbook · Streaming API · No AKS / No local dashboard

기간·모델·live/fixture·Run UUID로 조회합니다. 비용은 Azure public retail 추정이며 invoice가 아닙니다. 과거 null 비용의 재계산은 별도 price basis로 표시합니다.

## 1 · 운영 현황
Fixture는 실제 서비스 실패나 청구가 아닙니다. Unknown usage/price를 0으로 대체하지 않습니다.

content.title: 요청·사용량·비용 KPI
content.query:
let PriceSnapshot = datatable(Model:string, Version:string, Sku:string, InputUsd:real, CachedUsd:real, OutputUsd:real, MaxPrompt:long, From:datetime, To:datetime)
[
  "gpt-6-luna", "2026-09-22", "GlobalStandard", 0.1, 0.01, 0.5, 4096, datetime(2026-10-14), datetime(2026-11-14),
  "gpt-5.6-luna", "2026-07-09", "GlobalStandard", 0.2, 0.02, 1.2, 4096, datetime(2026-10-14), datetime(2026-11-14),
  "gpt-5.6-terra", "2026-07-09", "GlobalStandard", 2, 0.2, 12, 4096, datetime(2026-10-14), datetime(2026-11-14)
];
let RunFilter = tostring(dynamic({RunId:json}));
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Properties["telemetry.kind"] == "aoai.request"
| where tostring(Properties["demo.mode"]) == "{Mode}"
| extend Deployment=tostring(Properties["aoai.deployment"]), Model=tostring(Properties["gen_ai.request.model"]),
  Version=tostring(Properties["aoai.model_version"]), Sku=tostring(Properties["aoai.deployment_sku"]),
  RunId=tostring(Properties["demo.run_id"]), Outcome=tostring(Properties["aoai.outcome"]),
  Status=toint(Properties["aoai.status_code"]), Prompt=tolong(Properties["aoai.prompt_tokens"]),
  Completion=tolong(Properties["aoai.completion_tokens"]), Cached=tolong(Properties["aoai.cached_tokens"]),
  Known=tobool(Properties["aoai.usage_known"]), Annotated=tobool(Properties["aoai.filter_observed"]),
  RecordedCost=todouble(Properties["aoai.estimated_cost_usd"]), Streaming=tobool(Properties["aoai.streaming"]),
  TTFT=todouble(Properties["aoai.ttft_ms"]), Gap=todouble(Properties["aoai.inter_chunk_mean_ms"]),
  Completed=tobool(Properties["aoai.stream_completed"])
| where "{Deployment}" == "all" or Deployment == "{Deployment}"
| where "{Model}" == "all" or Model == "{Model}"
| where "{StreamType}" == "all" or tostring(Streaming) == "{StreamType}"
| where isempty(RunFilter) or RunId == RunFilter
| lookup kind=leftouter PriceSnapshot on Model, Version, Sku
| extend RetailRepriced=iff(Known and tostring(Properties["aoai.cost_reason"]) != "price_scope_unsupported" and isnotnull(InputUsd) and Prompt <= MaxPrompt and TimeGenerated >= From and TimeGenerated < To,
  ((Prompt-Cached)*InputUsd + Cached*CachedUsd + Completion*OutputUsd)/1000000.0, real(null))
| extend EstimatedUsd=coalesce(RecordedCost, RetailRepriced), PriceBasis=iff(isnotnull(RecordedCost), "recorded rate version", iff(isnotnull(RetailRepriced),"current Azure retail snapshot reprice","unknown"))
| summarize Attempts=count(), Successes=countif(Outcome=="success"), InputTokens=sum(Prompt), OutputTokens=sum(Completion),
  KnownUsage=countif(Known), PricedAttempts=countif(isnotnull(EstimatedUsd)), EstimatedUsd=sum(EstimatedUsd)
| extend EstimatedUsd=iff(PricedAttempts==0,real(null),EstimatedUsd), UsageCoveragePct=iff(Attempts==0,real(null),100.0*KnownUsage/Attempts)

## 2 · Streaming SLO
TTFT는 첫 visible content까지의 client 시간입니다. Role-only chunk는 TTFT가 아닙니다. Chunk gap은 token TBT가 아닙니다.

| where "{Model}" == "all" or Model == "{Model}"
| where "{StreamType}" == "all" or tostring(Streaming) == "{StreamType}"
| where isempty(RunFilter) or RunId == RunFilter
| lookup kind=leftouter PriceSnapshot on Model, Version, Sku
| extend RetailRepriced=iff(Known and tostring(Properties["aoai.cost_reason"]) != "price_scope_unsupported" and isnotnull(InputUsd) and Prompt <= MaxPrompt and TimeGenerated >= From and TimeGenerated < To,
  ((Prompt-Cached)*InputUsd + Cached*CachedUsd + Completion*OutputUsd)/1000000.0, real(null))
| extend EstimatedUsd=coalesce(RecordedCost, RetailRepriced), PriceBasis=iff(isnotnull(RecordedCost), "recorded rate version", iff(isnotnull(RetailRepriced),"current Azure retail snapshot reprice","unknown"))
| project TimeGenerated, Deployment, Outcome, Status, TTFT, DurationMs, Streaming, Completed, Prompt, Completion, Cached, EstimatedUsd, RecordedCost, PriceBasis, RunId, OperationId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100

content.json:
## 6 · Capacity / PAYG spillover
현재 세 배포는 GlobalStandard PAYG입니다. PTU utilization / PTU→PAYG spillover는 **N/A**이며 0이나 token−quota 계산으로 만들지 않습니다. 실제 PTU를 도입하면 native UtilizationV2와 IsSpillover dimension을 조회합니다.

Azure/agentops#343의 구획을 채택하되 legacy Latency/BlockedCalls/TotalCalls를 AOAI 전용 지표로 혼용하지 않습니다.

## 7 · Azure native Alert / Governance
Action Group 테스트 발송 성공과 실제 rule Fired/inbox 수신은 별도 증거입니다. Native metrics는 모든 서비스 호출을 포함하고 workbook의 mode/run filter와 scope가 다릅니다.
